subject: Annual Leave Policy Update — Effective November 1
body_html:
Dear Team,

Please be advised that the annual leave policy has been updated effective November 1, 2026. Key changes include:

  • Leave must be requested 5 business days in advance
  • Carry-over limit is now 10 days

The full policy document is available on the intranet.

Regards,
HR Team
